_about: Raw mouse input (14 Nov 2026; setting mouse_raw from 497d794e, the owner's order: on by default, a must-have option): a Player-tier row first in MORE / SYSTEM beside the other core rows (fluf_windows, maneuver_watchdog), so it shows whatever modules are on; Player tier because MORE's simple view is full at the Large size (docs\UI_OPTIONS.md 1). Apply with specpatch.py to part2_data.js and docs/UI_SPEC.json (and the artifact's ui/spec, pinned set, after reading). Registry: core\ui\shared_rows.h FLV_ROW_MOUSE_RAW; the listener: core\host\dimouse.cpp.

rows.label: Raw mouse input
rows.help: The cursor moves the same distance for the same hand movement at any mouse speed: Windows' pointer acceleration does not reach the game.
